verdict.rationale: BAMF is a public information website, and any such site could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes human-facing content (migration and residence information, integration offers, asylum procedures, statistics). Nothing in it mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs or agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
